svg.title: Chromosome tool capability specimen
svg.desc: Original schematic examples: plain rod, reproducible bands, optional centromere, and joined sisters. Deletion removes C from ABCD, centromere, EF to give ABD, centromere, EF at the same length scale. Reciprocal translocation exchanges distal DE and PQ between AB, centromere, CDE and MN, centromere, OPQ. Both products retain their centromeres: AB, centromere, CPQ and MN, centromere, ODE. Three numbered exon blocks are separated by two thin introns in genomic DNA and adjacent in mature RNA and cDNA. Decorative bands and lengths do not represent measured cytogenetic or genomic maps. Original artwork; copyright 2026 Neil R. Voss.
